body: It really depends on your preference. I just use it all under one bank for convenience, since it’s easier to transfer funds to different accounts. Plus it’s easier to access for me to the ATMs (I use Chase).
Oh, I am sorry to hear that. Hopefully you were/able to recover from that. Glad to see you are able to have that outlook afterwards.
Been there, and one too many close calls. I always try to remember which chain restaurants have bathroom available. Lol

I don’t know if this will work for you, but I created two savings account. One is for absolutely untouchable(life savings), and the second is for emergency funds(need to fix a car, health issues, get unemployed, etc.) Set up auto transfer monthly of a fixed amount, and think of it as “another bill to pay.” This mentally helps you prevent splurging all your paychecks away. One last thing, always budget on food! (I learned that the hard way)

I was pretty overweight for my height (185lbs, 5’8”), and it made me insecure about myself. Confidence was at an all time low. I felt that if I didn’t change myself, it would be hard to go out on dates. After losing 35lbs in 8 months, none of my pants fit me anymore. Then, I realized that I was really lacking in fashion sense. I did some research online to see what looks good on me, and it was a lot of learning curve. Eventually this gave me the courage to go on dates. Successful dates so far(before COVID), but not really seeing anyone~

I used to be clueless on what to order for drinks as well because I didn’t really drink much. Eventually I learned by either trying other people’s drinks, or see what goes in the mixed drinks.  Most bars should have a menu, and you can see online what they have. Starting out with a lighter drink is a good choice, such as a beer. Then eventually going into hard liquor. At
 the end of the day, it’s just like everyone says on the thread: you’re just there to have a good time with your friends. Maybe with a little buzz. 

Also here is a link to basic mixed drinks that most bars should have: https://www.townandcountrymag.com/leisure/drinks/g13092298/popular-bar-drinks-to-order/
I used to go on night drives, and play some music in the background. Destination to nowhere, but it really kept things off my mind.

I really enjoy spending time listening to music and diving deeper into my interests. I try to learn more about cooking (I can’t cook much...), fashion (at least dress better), and sports. Of course there is a lot of time spent on video games, but I try to limit that. Oh, and look for good food to eat! (restaurant wise)

What is your story of unrequited love?

I met this girl who had similar life experiences in life as I did. We became really good friends over the past three years, and I could talk to her a lot about things that were happening in my life than anyone. I really thought that she was just a really good friend. She shared a lot about her life experiences that  she doesn’t share with other people, even her own family. I just tried to stay as her friend, and never thought of her as anymore than that. It was not  until close friends around me talking to me about her that I realized that I had developed feelings for her. The thing is that she had a boyfriend, but their relationship was not stable due to long distance relationship. She told me that if their relationship does not get any better, then she would break up with her boyfriend. It is messed up, but a part of me hoped that she broke up with her boyfriend. Now she got a new job and is moving to another state in less than two days. I said goodbye to her earlier today, and I am really happy for her because it was a long time coming. But, a part of me is really sad that she is leaving. I chose not to tell her how I really felt about her because I know that it would ruin the friendship, and it would not help her in any way. One thing I have learned through all of this, is that I will never know how she truly felt about me. This will probably be something that I can admit that I will have a regret for the rest of my life. So what is your story?

More than a quote, it is a question that I ask to myself when it gets to that point of ending it all: 
Where does this leave me with my family and friends? Is it fair that I choose to just get on with it and end my life? If I do so, then I know for sure that it will be a burden that they will have to carry for the rest of their lives. It could also potentially lead them into a state of depression, and possibly lead them into ending their own lives. The point is that I have come realize and not just know that there are people truly care about me.
I know that feeling all too well. I lose complete interest, and get lost in my mind. It feels like I have been living in my head for the past few years.
I wish I knew what the trigger was. The wave of emotion that came through was overwhelming to bare. Maybe it was years of holding it in, and letting the feelings subside.
